summary: DeFi Technologies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer reporting on Form 6-K, furnished its interim condensed consolidated financial statements, management's discussion and analysis, and CEO/CFO interim certifications (Form 52-109F2, the Canadian equivalent of Sarbanes-Oxley 302 certifications) for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly reporting package containing no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or structural mechanics. No price, stake, premium, closing date, or breakup fee is stated. No special-situation angle applies; there is no risk-arb event to monitor.
